d:
A Delhi Police constable has been accused of demanding dowry and calling off his wedding after allegedly insisting on a Maruti Suzuki Brezza instead of the Hyundai Aura car promised by the bride's family. The incident took place in Sonipat, Haryana, where the groom, identified as Kuldeep, allegedly returned with his wedding procession without getting married. Watch the video to know more.
